OPERATION NOTE

Patient: [redacted]   MRN: [redacted]   DOB: [redacted]
Hospital: [redacted]   Theatre 4
Date of operation: 14/03/2026
Surgeon: [redacted] (Consultant Colorectal Surgeon)
Assistant: [redacted] (ST6)
Urology: [redacted] (Consultant Urologist)
Anaesthetist: [redacted]
Anaesthetic: GA + bilateral TAP blocks
ASA: III
Urgency: Elective

Planned procedure: Laparoscopic reversal of Hartmann's procedure and repair of incisional hernia. Consented for possible open conversion and defunctioning loop ileostomy.

Indication: 68M, Hartmann's procedure (emergency laparotomy) June 2025 for perforated sigmoid diverticulitis with purulent peritonitis. Post-op course complicated by midline wound infection requiring VAC therapy, with subsequent 6cm incisional hernia at the lower midline. Pre-op CT and flexible sigmoidoscopy of rectal stump satisfactory. Wishes to proceed to reversal.

Procedure:
Lloyd-Davies position. Cystoscopy and bilateral 6Fr ureteric stents placed by urology team to aid identification of ureters (to be removed at end of case).
Open Hasson entry left upper quadrant, 2 x 5mm ports. Dense adhesions of small bowel to the anterior abdominal wall and pelvis. Laparoscopic adhesiolysis attempted for 40 mins but unable to safely progress; converted to open via previous midline scar, excising the hernia sac.
Extensive adhesiolysis. During adhesiolysis a 1cm full-thickness enterotomy made in the distal ileum approx 60cm from the ileocaecal valve. Repaired primarily in 2 layers with 3-0 PDS; no contamination.
End colostomy taken down and descending colon mobilised; splenic flexure mobilisation required for tension-free reach. Rectal stump identified with aid of rigid sigmoidoscope and mobilised. Colorectal anastomosis fashioned end-to-end with 29mm circular stapler, doughnuts complete, air leak test negative.
Given the enterotomy, prolonged adhesiolysis and patient comorbidity, decision made intraoperatively to defunction: loop ileostomy fashioned in the right iliac fossa (site pre-marked).
Incisional hernia repaired with retrorectus (sublay) mesh: Ethicon Prolene mesh 15 x 30cm, LOT PM2291847, fixed with 2-0 Prolene. Posterior and anterior sheath closed with looped 1 PDS.
20Fr Robinson drain to pelvis. Skin clips. Local anaesthetic infiltration to wounds.
Ureteric stents removed at end of case.

Findings: Dense small bowel adhesions. Healthy rectal stump approx 15cm from anal verge. No residual diverticular disease in the descending colon. 6cm lower midline incisional hernia containing omentum.

Complications: Enterotomy as above, repaired.
EBL: approx 350ml
Operative time: 262 minutes

Outcome: Hartmann's reversed as planned but converted to open; additional unplanned defunctioning loop ileostomy formed.

Post-op plan:
- Enhanced recovery pathway, free fluids tonight, diet as tolerated
- Stoma nurse review day 1
- Remove pelvic drain when output <100ml/24h
- Extended VTE prophylaxis 28 days
- Gastrografin enema at 8 weeks, then list for ileostomy closure if anastomosis intact
- Abdominal binder 6 weeks, no heavy lifting 3 months

--- Theatre record (auto-populated) ---
Intraoperative complications: [x] None
Estimated blood loss (nursing): 300ml
Urinary catheter: 14Fr Foley inserted in theatre
Specimen: Hernia sac - histology
Note signed: 16/03/2026 08:42
